summary: Italy (IT) localization of Business Central 29. It covers Italian VAT (settlement, registers, VAT transactions reports, nondeductible VAT), withholding tax and INPS contributions, customer and vendor bills, FatturaPA e-invoicing, Intrastat, fiscal inventory valuation, Italian fixed asset depreciation and legacy subcontracting.
overview:
The Italian layer is large: 553 objects, 829 fields added to W1 tables, 92 events and 338 procedures. Most W1 changes are fields on documents, ledgers and setup tables (Operation Type, Operation Occurred Date, Activity Code, Service Tariff No., Deductible %, Fiscal Code, Refers to Period). They support VAT, VAT transactions reporting and fiscal identification of customers, vendors and the company. Posting codeunits such as Gen. Jnl.-Post Line (12), Sales-Post (80) and Purch.-Post (90) get new events and procedures for bills, unrealized VAT, withholding tax and payment lines.

Own objects cover withholding tax and INPS contributions, customer and vendor bills with SEPA and CBI export, periodic VAT settlement, Spesometro and declaration of intent exports, FatturaPA and Datifattura export, Intrastat Report extensions, LIFO and fiscal inventory valuation, payment lines for installment terms, and compressed and alternate depreciation. A Service declaration for IT and a legacy subcontracting feature set (with an IT Subcontracting Migration app) are also present.

Microsoft Learn documents most of this under the Italy local functionality pages: VAT reporting, VAT transactions reports (prepare, create, correct, export), VAT statements, G/L Book and VAT register printing, withholding tax, bills and payments, fixed assets, Intrastat, fiscal inventory valuation, FatturaPA and subcontracting migration.
key_points: VAT: settlement report 20, VAT Statement, nondeductible VAT, VAT identifiers, VAT registers, annual VAT communication and periodic VAT payment XML.
VAT transactions reports: threshold-based suggest lines, validation, corrective and cancellation reports, CCF export and mark as submitted.
Withholding tax and INPS contributions with vendor codes, computed entries, payment lists and export.
Customer and vendor bills with bill posting groups, ABI/CAB, SEPA credit transfer and direct debit, issued and posted bill lists.
FatturaPA electronic invoicing with Fattura codes, setup, document types, project info and self-billing documents.
Intrastat report extensions, service tariff numbers, customs offices and service declarations.
Fiscal inventory valuation with LIFO categories, year-end costs and Before Start Item Cost.
Fixed assets: anticipated, accelerated and reduced depreciation, compressed depreciation, and multiple asset cards on purchase posting.

areas.what: Core Italian VAT and ledger changes. Gen. Jnl.-Post Line gets bill, unrealized VAT and nondeductible VAT procedures and events. VAT Entry, VAT Posting Setup, General Ledger Setup and Gen. Journal Line gain many fields. VAT report objects are extended, and own codeunits cover Spesometro, withholding tax, declaration of intent and periodic VAT payment XML.
areas.why: Learn describes periodic VAT reports, VAT transactions reports with thresholds, VAT statements and G/L Book printing as Italian tax compliance requirements.

areas.what: Bills for customers and vendors, ABI/CAB and BBAN on bank accounts, SEPA credit transfer and direct debit adaptations, and withholding tax contribution pages. Payment Method gets bill and Fattura PA fields.
areas.why: Learn explains automatic bills and SEPA-based vendor payments and customer bills for Italy.

areas.what: Italian counterparts for service documents: payment lines, Fattura support, posted document edit pages and service declaration (Intrastat for services) codeunits, enums and page extensions.

Intrastat Report extensions and journal fields, transport documents (TDD) fields on transfer orders, customs offices, LIFO and fiscal valuation reports, and subcontracting WIP fields on item and transfer lines.
areas.why: Learn covers Intrastat setup and printing for Italy and fiscal inventory valuation methods (average, FIFO, LIFO, discrete LIFO).

areas.what: Sales documents and customer get Italian fields: operation type, operation occurred date, activity code, fiscal code, tax representative, bank receipts and interest on arrears. Sales-Post gets payment line and VAT report procedures with events. Split VAT lines and prepayment period checks are added.
areas.why: Learn describes the individual person, resident and tax representative data needed for VAT transactions reports.

areas.what: Purchase documents and vendor get Italian fields: operation type, activity code, withholding and social security codes, birth and residence data, bill fields. Purch.-Post adds withholding tax and fixed asset splitting. Customs authority vendors are new.
areas.why: Learn covers withholding tax setup on vendors and purchase invoices, and creating multiple fixed asset cards on posting.

areas.what: Legacy Italian subcontracting: subcontracting orders, transfer orders, prices, dispatch and return reports, WIP item fields on routing and capacity entries, plus migration and legacy feature handlers.
areas.why: Learn states that Italian subcontracting is deprecated and hidden by default, with migration to the new Subcontracting app.

areas.what: Company Information gets Italian fiscal fields. Payment Terms gain installment payment lines, with own tables for payment lines, fixed due dates and deferring due dates. Also company officials, company types, operation types and No. Series types.
areas.why: Learn documents company information setup and payment terms with installment percentages for Italy.

areas.what: FatturaPA electronic invoicing: export codeunit, sales and service validation, Fattura header, line, code and setup tables, document types, project info and self-billing documents.
areas.why: Learn covers FatturaPA setup, document type codes and self-billing configuration.

areas.what: Alternate depreciation (anticipated, accelerated, reduced), compressed depreciation on journal posting, new fields on Depreciation Book and tables, and an Italian Depreciation Book report.
areas.why: Learn describes these depreciation methods and compressed depreciation for Italian fixed assets.

areas.what: Local helpers: activity codes, appointment codes, Spesometro appointments, fiscal code check setup and report management codeunits.
Flat file management, blacklist communication amounts and document relation tables used by the Italian reports.
Permission sets LOCAL, LOCAL READ and VAT Report - Edit are changed for the Italian objects.
Feature management for Italy and application area localization, including the legacy subcontracting application area.
Employee gets birth place fields, and employee entry application gets VAT settlement checks.
Cash Flow Worksheet Line gets new events and procedures for posted and unposted documents and payment tolerance.
Contact gets a Fiscal Code field and a transport document address helper.
Job Transfer Line adds reverse charge VAT amount calculation and an event for purchase lines.

issues: The overview groups alternate depreciation with Italy's own objects, but the code adds it mostly through changes to W1 objects (Depreciation Book and Depreciation Table Line fields, depreciation calculation codeunits). Only compressed depreciation has its own table (Compress Depreciation).
Learn says Italian subcontracting is deprecated and hidden by default from version 28.3. The narrative's 'legacy' label is accurate but could say this directly.
One Learn page on printing Intrastat reports is marked deprecated. The narrative's focus on the Intrastat Report extensions is still correct.
